record.title: Falsify a wrong-name acquired catalog candidate
record.intent: Prove the original consumer rejects a48byte invalid candidate while preserving the acquired FlexA seed.
requirements: Run exactly one invalid BWU05T08 candidate through the unchanged stock decoder/consumer/ordinary installer in an isolated disposable guest; no physical access.
Require all three consumer blocks observed, original rejection, unchanged full catalog and no candidate license file. Preserve any private attempt-record delta rather than calling rejection a no-op.
Independently verify and seal the conclusion; commit and push before a clean positive branch. Do not use rejected state as the positive seed.
acceptance: A verified rejection or precise unexpected result is preserved.
